about: Blast-radius model of the kgirl harness (src/kgirl/harness, commit 26748c4) from code inspection, plus the porter-blast-radius bridge that reads its Atlas. Controls marked implemented exist in the code; controls marked proposed are recommended fixes. Evaluate with as_built=true to see today's system.

C-CURATOR.mechanism: curator.propose stores new fragments as staged; recall serves only active; promotion needs support >= k, LCB(utility) >= p and the validator.

C-EXACT-ONCE.mechanism: Jev edits are SEARCH/REPLACE blocks applied only when SEARCH matches exactly once, in per-agent sandbox copies.

C-FALLBACK.mechanism: Hermes role router falls back along a chain when a backend is unavailable.

C-PARSER-VERSION.mechanism: Ingest is keyed by content sha and PARSER_VERSION, so a parser change re-parses affected files.

C-PARSE-REPORT.mechanism: Files that fail to parse are recorded (files.parse_error) and counted in the report; their imports are still missing from the graph.

C-READONLY.mechanism: porter-blast-radius opens atlas.db with SQLite's read-only flag.

C-SCHEMA-CHECK.mechanism: The bridge checks every column it reads and names missing ones; a contract test runs kgirl's own indexer.

C-SANITIZE.mechanism: porter-blast-radius strips control and bidi characters from output and tells the client model text is data.

C-STAGE-MCP.mechanism: soup_remember stores fragments as staged with source=mcp and no credit (not via curator.propose, whose near-duplicate reinforcement would let a model promote its own memory), and the curator never auto-promotes source=mcp: a human promotes them.

C-VERIFY-ALLOWLIST.mechanism: jev_swarm_task accepts only verify commands from a user-configured allowlist, run with a scrubbed environment; the model cannot supply a program.

C-APPLY-CONFIRM.mechanism: apply=true over MCP is refused unless repo_path is an indexed repo root and the user confirms outside the model.

C-DATA-FRAMING.mechanism: kgirl's MCP server sends initialize instructions and frames atlas and soup text as untrusted data.
C-DATA-FRAMING.verify: initialize instructions added in 9x25dillon/kgirl#55; per-result framing still proposed

C-REDACT.mechanism: Secret-pattern redaction of signatures, docstrings and source lines before a context pack goes to the scout model.

C-VERSION-NEGOTIATION.mechanism: initialize answers with a supported protocol version instead of echoing whatever the client sent.

failureModes.title: soup_remember stores model-written memory as active and labelled source=user, bypassing the curator's staging; it is recalled in every later session
jev_swarm_task runs a model-supplied verify command with the user's full environment (API keys included)
apply=true writes the winning diff into any repo_path the model names
Docstrings and signatures from indexed third-party repos reach the agent unframed through atlas_* tools
Signatures (with default values), docstrings and source lines go to the scout model without redaction
Files that fail to parse drop their imports, so blast radius silently misses their dependents (19 in kgirl)
Bare module names resolve to same-named files in other repos, creating cross-repo couplings that may not exist
Hundreds of cloned bodies (884 kgirl symbols in numbskull): a fix in one repo leaves the defect in the other
initialize echoes any client protocol version, including unsupported ones
An Atlas schema change breaks the porter bridge
